items.text: Create polished party invites with banners, max guests, club targeting, direct emails/usernames, and a public share link
Invited members now see party invite banners on their dashboard and club pages until they RSVP
Public guests must RSVP before they can see who else is going
Public guests can opt in to ClubPal emails for party updates, reminders, and host changes
Invite motion styles now include fireworks, aurora, spotlight, confetti, and sparkles
